# Project Overview

Build a React web application that contains three features:

- Register
- Login
- Logout

The application does NOT have a real backend.

All APIs are mocked.

All data is stored inside browser Local Storage.

The goal is NOT to build production software.

The goal is:

- Clean architecture
- Clean code
- Good folder structure
- Easy to maintain
- Easy to test

The application should follow modern React best practices.

This project should be implemented as if it were a production project, despite using Local Storage.
